chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said) said: It was narrated to me by Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Muffadhal ibn Umar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

One who narrates a report from a believer with the intention of exposing his faults and destroying his dignity so that he falls from the eyes of the people, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will remove him from His guardianship and transfer him to the guardianship of Satan.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of exposing a believer's faults with malicious intent?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-Amaal*, this hadith details the specific mechanism of spiritual displacement where malicious gossip (*ghibah*) with intent to humiliate (*shayn*) causes a believer to be ejected from divine guardianship (*wilayah Allah*) and transferred to Satan's domain. This transition underscores the Shia concept of *wilayah* as a dynamic state of spiritual proximity that can be lost through specific moral failures, particularly the destruction of a fellow believer's honor (*murubah*).

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Abi al-Qasim from Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad b. Sinan from al-Muffadhal b. Umar from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:

“One who repeats the words of a believer with an intention to expose him, insult his personality or reduce his respect among the people, Allah will take away His guardianship and make Shaitaan as his guardian.”
